name: Foam Roller Seated Chest Stretch
steps: Sit upright on the floor with your knees bent or legs extended and place a foam roller horizontally on the floor directly behind your hips.
Reach both hands behind you to rest your palms on the foam roller with your fingers pointing backward and arms straight.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together while gently rolling the foam roller slightly farther back to open your chest and front shoulders.
Hold the stretched position while breathing slowly and deeply, then walk your hands back in gently to release.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and shoulders pulled away from your ears rather than hunching your neck.
Move only as far back as feels like a mild, comfortable stretch across the front of your shoulders.
